title: Card transactions uncategorised or personal-looking
prompt: List card transactions in the last closed month that are uncategorized or look personal (gym, groceries, entertainment with no business note).

setup.q: What does the card policy say about receipts, categories and business notes?
Who holds a card and who approves their spend?

steps: pull the month's card transactions with category and memo
flag uncategorised rows and rows whose merchant or category reads as personal with no business note
group by cardholder with the reason each was flagged

done.text: Every exception row cites the transaction id and the cardholder
Rows are flagged for follow-up, never judged
card-transactions-to-review.xlsx opens with Exceptions first (count and total on the first rows), a Tie-out block whose Difference is 0.00, and no internal plumbing words
